Build signed CLI update feed:
set -euo pipefail
          key_check="$RUNNER_TEMP/update-key-check"
          node deployment/release/check-update-signing-key.mjs \
            --maturity "${RELEASE_MATURITY}" \
            --roots deployment/release/fleet-trust-roots.json \
            --github-output "$key_check"
          cat "$key_check" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if ! grep -qx 'available=true' "$key_check"; then exit 0; fi
          update_key_id="$(sed -n 's/^key_id=//p' "$key_check")"
          test -n "$update_key_id"
          created_at="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
          payload_dir="dist/update-payloads"
          feed_tree_root="dist/update-feed-tree"
          feed_dir="${feed_tree_root}/update-feed"
          out_dir="dist/update-feed"
          rm -rf "${payload_dir}" "${feed_tree_root}" "${out_dir}"
          mkdir -p "${payload_dir}" "${out_dir}"
          feed_args=(--out-dir "${feed_dir}" --generated-at "${created_at}")
          targets=(
            "darwin amd64 tar.gz"
            "darwin arm64 tar.gz"
            "linux amd64 tar.gz"
            "linux arm64 tar.gz"
            "windows amd64 zip"
          )
          echo "target_count=${#targets[@]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
            read -r target_os target_arch target_ext <<< "${target}"
            archive_path="dist/cli/spacedatanetwork-${VERSION}-${target_os}-${target_arch}.${target_ext}"
            payload_out="${payload_dir}/${target_os}-${target_arch}"
            if [[ ! -f "${archive_path}" ]]; then
              echo "missing CLI archive for update feed: ${archive_path}" >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            # Must match the channel the bundles above were stamped with,
            # or the shipped updater reads a feed index nobody publishes.
            node deployment/release/build-cli-update-payload.mjs \
              --bundle-archive "${archive_path}" \
              --version "${VERSION}" \
              --sequence "${SDN_UPDATE_SEQUENCE}" \
              --channel release \
              --platform "${target_os}" \
              --arch "${target_arch}" \
              --key-id "${update_key_id}" \
              --created-at "${created_at}" \
              --out-dir "${payload_out}"
            feed_args+=(--entry "${payload_out}/manifest.json:${payload_out}/update.wasm")
          done
          node deployment/release/build-sdn-update-feed.js "${feed_args[@]}"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/sdn-signal-signer/bin/spacedatanetwork" update sign-signals \
            --key-env SDN_UPDATE_SIGNING_KEY_PEM --feed-dir "${feed_dir}" \
            --roots deployment/release/fleet-trust-roots.json
Verify and pack the signed CLI update fe:
set -euo pipefail
          feed_tree_root="dist/update-feed-tree"
          feed_dir="${feed_tree_root}/update-feed"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/sdn-signal-signer/bin/spacedatanetwork" update sign-signals --verify-only \
            --feed-dir "${feed_dir}" --roots deployment/release/fleet-trust-roots.json
          # What an installed node will check, checked here first: every
          # manifest against fleet-trust-roots.json (signature, target, expiry,
          # payload hashes), no SEC-001 key, no trust/ in any payload, and the
          # index agreeing with its manifests.
          node deployment/release/verify-cli-update-feed.mjs \
            --feed-dir "${feed_dir}" \
            --roots deployment/release/fleet-trust-roots.json \
            --expect-version "${VERSION}" \
            --expect-count "${EXPECTED_TARGETS}"
          tar -czf "dist/update-feed/spacedatanetwork-update-feed-${VERSION}.tar.gz" -C "${feed_tree_root}" update-feed
